- 20 Nov: revision 3, then revision 4. Step 1 (next confirmed daily cycle low, any price) was met on the bar of 20 Nov. The plan's checkpoint, captured just after step 1 was met (21 Nov), holds two illustrated routes.

Cycle windows, as drawn and today: neither was redrawn. The daily low window opens 23 Dec, has its centre 7 Jan and closes 20 Jan, in both the plan and today. Where it stands now: step 1 is met and step 2 is not. Step 2 needs either a higher daily cycle low or a bullish daily trend-line break, and if either happens every step is met and the thesis is complete. The thesis would be challenged by a daily close below the latest confirmed daily cycle low. This says what would count, not what will happen.

The first leg is drawn from the centre of the daily low window (7 Jan, extrapolated), the 75th percentile of the daily low depth band and the 3-bar confirmation lag. The second leg is drawn from the same default cycle length and ends at a break of the challenge level (a daily close below the latest confirmed daily cycle low).
